fields.description: Who this line pays. Every volunteer named here must appear on the paired progress report: the report says who the period was about, and paying somebody it never mentioned would be a payment with no narrative behind it.
fields.label: Volunteer

fields.description: The day this line is about. One row per volunteer per day is what makes the grid a grid: the total payable for a volunteer is the sum of their rows, and who attended on a given day is the rows carrying that date. Must fall inside the paired report's period, and a volunteer may appear only once on a day.
fields.label: Date

fields.description: Whether the volunteer was there that day. An absent day may still be recorded, which is why the row exists at all, but it cannot carry a stipend: a daily stipend is paid for attending.
fields.label: Attended

fields.description: Hours served that day, where a society records them. Reporting only: nothing computes a stipend from hours, because the rate a society pays and how it derives one are its own decisions and no rate is assumed here.
fields.label: Hours

fields.description: What this day is worth to this volunteer, in the form's currency. Typed by the society, never computed from a rate this app invented. Never negative, and always zero on a day the volunteer did not attend.
fields.label: Stipend
